public_rationale: The PAL execution ablation demonstrates the modest claim Marcus makes. Performance fell substantially when the model had to simulate execution instead of using the Python runtime. That establishes a benefit from combining neural generation with symbolic execution on the tested tasks.
limitations: The finding concerns specific benchmarks and models.
The classification as neurosymbolic uses the broad workflow meaning supplied by Marcus's example.
It does not establish general architectural superiority or historical influence.

criteria.support_condition: A controlled comparison shows improved task performance when a language model's generated programs are executed by a symbolic runtime.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Relevant controlled comparisons establish that the supposed benefit disappears when other changes are controlled, with no demonstrated benefit from symbolic execution.
